snippet.title: Parking Garage Rally Circuit DX Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Release trailer for the new "DX" version of Parking Garage Rally Circuit, which combines the 8 US tracks from the original release with 8 brand new tracks set in western europe!

PGRC DX is now available on Wavedash: 
https://wavedash.gg/walaber-entertainment/pgrc

Console versions coming in early 2026!
European Tour content will be released as a DLC on Steam in early 2026 as well.
